findings.rationale: The discriminator uses operator "present". Under the specified predicate semantics, that operator tests whether a Quartz feature record exists; it does not test whether the record's stored value equals "present". Quartz records exist for both Nova and Cove, even though their stored values are respectively "present" and "absent". The discriminator therefore fails to encode the source's Nova-versus-Cove feature-value distinction and can change a discrimination-based hard-gate result or permitted conclusion.
